newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Bucharest bourse closes higher helped by chemicals.
newsitem.headline: Bucharest bourse closes higher helped by chemicals.

text.p: Investor interest in chemicals and pharmaceuticals helped to push the Bucharest stock market up on Friday, despite thin trading, brokers said.
"Investors showed some interest in Oltchim, Terapia and Antibiotice, but I don't think that's enough to drive the bourse to a new bullish phase next week," one broker said.
Three independent indices, the VAB, the BIG and the CAS-SE, based on average prices and market capitalisation, rose by 2.1, 2.17 and 2.15 percent respectively from Thursday.
Prices for 27 stocks were up, 22 closed down, while three listings had no trade and were suspended pending announcements.
Volumes thinned to 1.7 million shares from Thursday's 1.9 million, while turnover fell marginally to 7.2 billion lei from 7.9 billion previously.
On the first tier, chemical plant Oltchim and pharmaceuticals makers Antibiotice and Terapia took the bulk of turnover.
Oltchim firmed 200 lei to 4,150, while Antibiotice went up 300 lei to 7,800. Terapia closed 100 lei weaker to 11,300, despite some mid-day deals struck at 11,500, traders said.
Second-tier trading was sluggish, with Ciprom oil drilling equipment maker in the investors' limelight. Ciprom closed 140 lei up at 1,140.
